test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What was the minimum consumption expenditure (₹ per capita per month) set as a benchmark of the poverty line for rural India in 1979?
solution:
The correct answer is __**49.09**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Poverty line benchmark for **rural India in 1979**: **₹49 per capita per month**.
 
• Used by the **Planning Commission **to gauge **poverty rates and design policies**.
 
• Based on essential expenses for **food, clothing, and housing**.
 
• Guided development of **poverty alleviation programs**.
 
• Reviewed periodically to adjust for **economic changes**.
 
• Recognized variations in living **conditions among households**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MGNREGA** was implemented in** 2006** to address poverty through **rural employment**.

 
 
• Provides **100 days of wage employment per year **to rural households.
 
• Aims to enhance **livelihood security and create rural assets**.
 
• Contributes to **poverty reduction and social inclusion**.
 
• Faces challenges like **delays in wage payments **and **administrative inefficiencies**.
 
• Ongoing efforts to **strengthen implementation and effectiveness**.
 
 
 
• The **Public Distribution System **(PDS), ongoing since the **1940s**, provides **subsidised food to vulnerable populations to alleviate poverty**.
